_nathan_light_: Severin "Lucky" Light came up on Day 11 carrying news from Esterhaus. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Severin "Lucky" Light stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Severin "Lucky" Light and Wendel Deskodt made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
akkugrg2012: Isidor Akkugrg arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Isidor Akkugrg was waiting. Pavel Reider was grazed. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-C12 with the rations. Isidor Akkugrg ate while listening to the revised orders.

Isidor Akkugrg rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Lucien Jhomey was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land. Isidor Akkugrg got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 679. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Isidor Akkugrg wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Isidor Akkugrg found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
cosmicloopy: In Brennmoor, Silas Cosmicloopy was a lamplighter. In R-R13, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a lamplighter again.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Silas Cosmicloopy shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Silas Cosmicloopy has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Zeno Kallenfultz, badly wounded. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Silas Cosmicloopy helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Silas Cosmicloopy tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
grotesque_2023: Bram Grotesque found a place in T-F9 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

Bram Grotesque and Wendel Melioduff found a cat in the ruins at the Hanging Bridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Wendel. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at T-F9 changed before the cheering ended. Bram Grotesque shouldered another load.
Bram Grotesque borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
janzhhhhhhhhhh: Marek Janzhhhhhhhh left twin brothers too young to enlist behind in Greyhallow and came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox. The men noticed at once that he keeps feeding the rats.
Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall held the mirror while Marek Janzhhhhhhhh shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Marek Janzhhhhhhhh wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Marek Janzhhhhhhhh checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Marek Janzhhhhhhhh is number 560. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-S2 with the rations. Marek Janzhhhhhhhh ate while listening to the revised orders.
Marek Janzhhhhhhhh had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Arno "Tin" Ryukov was grazed.
joseph.olivas.3762: Pavel Olivas left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he never sits with his back to the parapet.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Pavel Olivas stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A stretcher party needed the passage. Pavel Olivas backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed. After the loss of Grey Mill, Pavel Olivas helped stack spare sandbags at Q-S9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A bullet clipped Pavel Olivas's helmet at Q-S9 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker of the Hegemony (@baronpapas_hobbybunker). Pavel Olivas counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Jonas Kieran was grazed.
linningorchid980: On the way to R-F6, Dietrich Linningorchi tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Dietrich Linningorchi checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
A bullet went through Dietrich Linningorchi's sleeve at R-F6 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Gustav "Mud" Raptor of the Concord (@raptor2561).

Dietrich Linningorchi wore a fresh bandage at R-F6 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Dietrich Linningorchi helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Dietrich Linningorchi sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow.
The medics cleaned Dietrich Linningorchi's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F6.
Dietrich Linningorchi was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Dietrich Linningorchi remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Dietrich Linningorchi could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Dietrich Linningorchi fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dietrich Linningorchi is number 200. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Dietrich Linningorchi walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Dietrich Linningorchi stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of R-F6, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
mems_and_broken_dreams: Oskar Dreams arrived on Day 12 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
redflamesofsteel: Teodor Redflamesofs came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Dawn watch. Teodor Redflamesofs put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Dorian "Hollow" Lucwar, badly wounded. Teodor Redflamesofs fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Norbert Jeremythomas, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Teodor Redflamesofs during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Teodor Redflamesofs across the shin at U-F15. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Matthias Landscapro of the Concord (@landscapro).
shpkunky: Dorian Shpkunky came up the line with a rosary of rough beads and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-C8 with the rations. Dorian Shpkunky ate while listening to the revised orders.

Dawn watch. Dorian Shpkunky put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jakub You, grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Dorian Shpkunky is number 637 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Dorian Shpkunky watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Dorian Shpkunky saw Benedikt Daremiamor freeze up on the fire step at Blackwater Canal. Dorian said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
tommy_35325774: Teodor Tommy walked into Q-F15 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Teodor Tommy was carrying water up to Q-F15 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Teodor Tommy did not. Shot by Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname of the Concord (@somebodynamednile). Teodor Tommy was hit at Q-F15 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname of the Concord (@somebodynamednile).

Roland "Ash" Tommy arrived carrying the family name of Teodor Tommy. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Roland "Ash" Tommy helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Roland "Ash" Tommy tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
weirddough___: Isidor Weirddough left an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive behind in Wyvern Cross and came up the line with a tin of tobacco. The men noticed at once that he shares cigarettes but never smokes.

Isidor Weirddough walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home found Isidor Weirddough before the night shift. Isidor Weirddough folded it small and kept it close.

Isidor Weirddough owes Roland Light so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. A letter from home found Isidor Weirddough before the night shift. Isidor Weirddough folded it small and kept it close. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Isidor Weirddough during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Isidor Weirddough waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found. A letter from home found Isidor Weirddough before the night shift. Isidor Weirddough folded it small and kept it close.
